empty.title: No boards yet
empty.description: Create a board for work, home or anything else, or bring in a board from Jira.

newBoard.title: New board
newBoard.description: Keep work, home and anything else on boards of their own.

delete.title: Delete “{board}”?
delete.description: {count, plural, =0 {The board is deleted. This can’t be undone.} one {The board and its # task are deleted. This can’t be undone.} other {The board and its # tasks are deleted. This can’t be undone.}}
delete.stopDescription: The board is removed from here. Nothing changes in Jira, and you can sync it again later.

jira.title: Sync a Jira board
jira.description: Work on a Jira board from here; every change stays in sync both ways.
jira.connectDescription: Sign in to Jira in Settings › Connectors, then come back to pick a board.
jira.noBoards: Your Jira account has no boards yet.
jira.howColumns: Columns and issues come from the Jira board.
jira.howMoves: Moving a card changes the issue’s status in Jira; new tasks become Jira issues.
jira.howChanges: Changes made in Jira show up here on their own.

banners.importingHint: Columns and issues appear here in a moment.
banners.offer: {count, plural, one {You have # open task in your workspaces. Show it on “{board}”?} other {You have # open tasks in your workspaces. Show them on “{board}”?}} Moving a card updates the task for your team.
banners.showHere: {count, plural, one {Show it here} other {Show them here}}

toasts.workspaceTasksOn: Your workspace tasks now show on “{board}”
toasts.workspaceTasksOff: Your workspace tasks no longer show on a board
toasts.workspaceTasksHint: Moving a card changes the task in its workspace.
toasts.workspaceTasksFailed: Couldn’t change where workspace tasks show
